All records, Firm or Assigned records only. Written only by the BFF (field-secured); locked once a version is Active (I-P4).
The ontology area the Procedure belongs to. Billing now (reuses sprk_policydomain).

The PERSON who asked for this record. Stamped by the BFF only (field-secured by scripts/Set-ChildRecordCreatorPersonSchema.ps1, which task 081 extends): createdby is the BFF application user for a record the BFF creates app-only, so this column is what records the person. ebilling-r1 task 080 (O-23; D-173 shape).
The external contact for the document (O-11).

The firm this Procedure governs. Required when Applies to is Firm and for a Procedure of type Rate card (I-P3); optional otherwise, and when set the firm condition applies from every source (O-20). Field-secured and scope-locked once a version is Active (I-P4). RESTRICT: a firm that is deleted while a Procedure names it is refused, because a nulled firm would widen a firm-only Procedure to every firm (task 080 proposal).
